display_name_prefix.description: Prefix on a provisioned account's display name; default Crewlet. Never empty — it is what marks an account as this company's.

org_id.description: Atlassian organization id from admin.atlassian.com; ${VAR} supported.

site_url.description: Human-readable site base for the settings links a permission report prints. Falls back to the jira/confluence blocks, then to the organization.

token_expiry_days.description: Lifetime of a minted agent token, 1-365 days. Default 300. Nothing renews it on a schedule; re-run the provisioner.

env.description: Extra environment for the CLI child process.

max_concurrent.description: Concurrent CLI processes; each costs 200-400 MB.

overrides.description: Field-wise overrides of the built-in CLI profile.

state_dir.description: Credential + per-seat home directory. Entries sharing one share a login.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap on one CLI invocation.

credential_bundle.description: ${VAR} holding a bundle exported by crewlet llm export.

cloud_id.description: Atlassian Cloud id. Give this or url, not both.

email.description: Set for Cloud Basic auth; omit for bearer-token auth.

site_url.description: Human-readable base for shareable links; needed with cloud_id.

skills_space.description: Space holding tool-skill pages; excluded from routing and knowledge search. Default TS; empty string disables tool skills entirely.

token.description: Admin API token or PAT; ${VAR} supported.

url.description: Instance URL. Give this or cloud_id, not both.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC secret for Data Center webhooks.

enabled.description: Record and replay per-conversation history (default on).

injected_max_chars.description: Byte budget for the injected block.

injected_max_entries.description: Entries injected into the prompt, newest N.

retention_days.description: How long a conversation is remembered.

budget_tokens.description: Soft token cap on the profiler call.

base_url.description: Endpoint for an openai-compatible embedding service.

dimensions.description: Vector width; must match the model's output size.

compacted_max_age_days.description: Age at which compacted summaries are dropped; 0 = never.

compaction_batch_size.description: Raw episodes pulled into one pass.

compaction_budget_tokens.description: Soft token cap on summarising one cluster.

compaction_jaccard_threshold.description: Similarity that pools two episodes into one cluster.

compaction_min_age_days.description: Only compact rows older than this.

consolidated_grace_days.description: Audit grace before a consolidated raw row is dropped.

exemplar_count.description: Originals kept raw after a cluster is compacted.

max_raw_episodes_per_agent.description: Raw episodes per seat that trigger a lifecycle pass.

non_terminal_max_age_days.description: Age at which mid-state episodes are dropped.

provisioning.description: Inputs for the provisioning CLI; ignored by the engine.

token.description: Read token for participant fan-out; empty degrades thread routing.

url.description: Enterprise Server base URL, e.g. https://github.example.com. Empty = github.com.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC secret for inbound deliveries; required when enabled.

org_webhook.description: auto (one org hook where the credential may), true, or false.

provisioning.description: Inputs for the provisioning CLI; ignored by the engine.

signing_secret.description: Standard-Webhooks signing token; required when enabled.

token.description: Read PAT for participants-based routing; empty degrades routing.

group.description: Top-level group the service accounts join.

group_webhook.description: auto (one group hook if the plan allows), true, or false.

projects.description: Extra projects to join and hook.

token_scopes.description: Scopes minted on each service-account token.

atlassian.description: Atlassian organization for provisioning per-seat service accounts. Read by crewlet atlassian provision and reported by GET /integrations; no routing or delivery decision reads it.

confluence.description: Confluence instance or Cloud site, org read account and webhook secret. Absent = disabled.

forge_app_id.description: Forge app id, verified against a relayed Cloud event's invocation token. Required for Jira or Confluence Cloud.

github.description: GitHub.com or Enterprise Server, webhook secret and provisioning. Absent = disabled.

gitlab.description: GitLab instance, webhook signing and provisioning. Absent = disabled.

jira.description: Jira instance or Cloud site, org read account and webhook secret. Absent = disabled.

mattermost.description: Mattermost instance and team. Absent = disabled.

slack.description: Slack working-indicator settings. Each seat carries its own app under role.integrations.slack. Absent = disabled.

cloud_id.description: Atlassian Cloud id. Give this or url, not both.

email.description: Set for Cloud Basic auth; omit for bearer-token auth.

site_url.description: Human-readable base for shareable links; needed with cloud_id.

token.description: Admin API token or PAT; ${VAR} supported.

url.description: Instance URL. Give this or cloud_id, not both.

confluence_spaces.description: Org-wide Confluence read scope. Empty = unscoped, bounded by each seat's own ACLs. Requires integrations.confluence.

api_keys.description: API keys, ${VAR} supported. Several rotate on rate-limit/auth errors.

base_url.description: Endpoint override, ${VAR} supported. Required for openai-compatible; optional for openai and anthropic (a gateway or proxy).

cli.description: The cli-agent block. Required for type cli-agent, refused otherwise.

reasoning.description: Enable extended thinking (openai and anthropic only).

reasoning_budget_tokens.description: Anthropic thinking budget in tokens when reasoning is on.

reasoning_effort.description: OpenAI reasoning effort when reasoning is on.

enabled.description: Master switch for agent learning (default on).

containment.description: direct (state isolation only) or container (host isolation).

image.description: Container image with the coding-agent CLI installed.

network.description: Container network; setting it to none also cuts off the coding agent's LLM.

run_args.description: Extra container run arguments. This is where a local box is sized.

headers.description: Headers sent with each request (http); ${VAR} supported.

name.description: Server name; the key seats declare credentials under.

shared.description: One shared instance (default), or false for one per seat.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: Connect, handshake and first tool listing budget.

tool_annotations.description: Per-tool behavioural-hint overrides, keyed by bare tool name.

tool_prefix.description: Prefix applied to this server's tool names.

provisioning.description: Inputs for the provisioning CLI; ignored by the engine.

team.description: Team slug the agent bots belong to.

typing_status.description: When to show the typing indicator (default off).

display_name_suffix.description: Suffix on each bot display name, e.g. " (AI)".

username_prefix.description: Prefix on each bot username, e.g. agent-.

max_refreshes_per_turn.description: Distinct memory refreshes one turn may make.

embeddings.description: Embedding provider for diary and episode recall.

llm.description: Named LLM providers; seats select one by key.

llm_order.description: Provider precedence; normally derived from the order they are written in.

sandbox.description: Code sandbox backend. Absent = no seat runs code.

budget_tokens.description: Soft token cap on the reflection call; 0 = uncapped.

enabled.description: Run reflection after each turn (default on).

persist_decider.description: Run the persist decision after each turn (default on).

summarize_episodes.description: Summarise episode hits through the auxiliary model (default on).

summarize_max_tokens.description: Soft cap on a per-hit summary.

availability.description: Human seats: free-text availability shown in rosters.

backstory.description: Who this seat is; reaches its prompt.

behavioral_guidelines.description: How this seat should work; reaches its prompt.

contact.description: Human seats: external account ids per surface.

email.description: Seat email; plus-addressing derives from the handle.

goal.description: What this seat is for; reaches its prompt.

handle.description: Canonical slug. Effectively permanent — it derives the seat's durable id.

learning_enabled.description: Override company learning for this seat.

llm.description: Provider key, chain, or per-phase mapping.

llm_auxiliary.description: Cheap model for reflection and summaries.

llm_judge.description: Cheap model for the round-cap extension judge.

llm_plan.description: Provider chain for Plan; wins over llm.plan.

llm_sandbox.description: Model the sandboxed coding agent runs on.

manages.description: Seats or units this seat manages; a unit expands to its seats.

mcp_env.description: Per-seat MCP credentials: env vars (stdio) or headers (http).

name.description: Unique seat name; also the source of the auto-derived handle.

placement.description: Which nodes may run this seat. Absent = any node that runs seats.

sandbox.description: Per-seat code sandbox gate. Absent = never offered.

schedules.description: Recurring work fired into this seat's inbox.

unit.description: Home unit for a root-level seat; the seat is moved into it.

products.description: Products this seat is licensed for. Absent block = all configured; empty list = none.

atlassian.description: Which Atlassian products this seat holds a licence for. Read by crewlet atlassian provision.

confluence.description: The Confluence space this seat owns.

jira.description: The Jira project this seat owns.

mattermost.description: This seat's Mattermost bot: one token covers everything.

slack.description: This seat's own Slack app: bot token and signing secret.

bot_token.description: Bot personal access token; one credential covers everything.

channel.description: Default channel name for this seat.

username.description: Bot username; defaults to the seat handle.

labels.description: Node labels that must all match.

node.description: Exact node id to pin this seat to.

coding_agent.description: Override the provider default for this seat.

enabled.description: Offer this seat the sandbox tool.

env.description: Env for this seat's sandbox run; declare external tokens here.

pause_ttl_seconds.description: Paused-box TTL. Unset (or negative) = provider default; 0 = never pause.

setup.description: Per-seat provisioning steps, applied after the engine-wide ones.

servers.description: MCP server names the coding agent may use.

bot_token.description: Bot token for outbound Web API calls.

channel.description: Default channel id for this seat.

signing_secret.description: Verifies inbound webhooks for this seat's app.

api_key.description: Remote sandbox API key; required for type e2b. ${VAR} supported.

default_coding_agent.description: Coding agent for seats that name none.

default_pause_ttl_seconds.description: Paused-box TTL before reap and re-seed. 0 = never pause.

default_timeout_seconds.description: Box TTL/keepalive. Not a run cap — the orphan-reclaim grace.

domain.description: Self-hosted sandbox cluster domain; empty = vendor cloud.

local.description: The local backend's block. Required for type local, refused otherwise.

setup.description: Provisioning steps applied to every box before per-seat extras.

template.description: Box template. This is where vCPU/RAM/disk are set — at template build time.

type.description: Backend: e2b, local, fake, or none. Required — there is no default.

brief.description: What this step made true about the box, told to the coding agent.

commands.description: Shell commands run in order; a non-zero exit fails the box.

env.description: Env merged into the run; resolved once at launch, not at load.

files.description: Files written into the box before commands run.

name.description: Short identifier used in logs and failure messages.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-command wall-clock cap for this step.

catchup_max_seconds.description: Upper clamp on the missed-tick catchup window.

catchup_min_seconds.description: Lower clamp on the missed-tick catchup window.

default_timezone.description: IANA zone for schedules that name none.

enabled.description: Master switch for the scheduler (default on).

jitter_seconds.description: Deterministic per-schedule jitter to spread a popular minute.

tick_seconds.description: Scheduler poll interval; under 60s catches every cron minute.

archive_after_days.description: Unused days before a skill is archived.

interval_hours.description: How often the curator walks the skill table.

stale_after_days.description: Unused days before a skill goes stale.

budget_tokens.description: Soft token cap per promotion draft.

enabled.description: Promote sibling skills to unit scope (default on).

jaccard_threshold.description: Similarity that pools two seats' skills.

min_sibling_count.description: Distinct seats a cluster needs before promotion.

auto_refine_on_failure.description: Append a counter-example when it failed (default on).

auto_refine_on_success.description: Append an observation when a skill's turn succeeded (default on).

max_body_chars.description: Ceiling on a refined skill's body.

budget_tokens.description: Soft token cap per draft attempt.

cluster_jaccard_threshold.description: Similarity that pools two turns into one cluster.

cluster_min_size.description: Turns a cluster needs before it earns a skill.

cluster_window_hours.description: How far back the clustering pass looks.

duplicate_jaccard_threshold.description: Reject a draft this similar to an existing skill.

episode_fetch_limit.description: Episodes pulled into one clustering pass.

min_tool_calls.description: Tool calls a turn needs before an inline draft.

scheduler_interval_seconds.description: How often the clustering pass runs.

typing_status.description: When to show the working indicator (default addressed).

default.description: Lines for any phase with no pool of its own.

onboarding.description: Lines shown during the first-turn onboarding pass.

delegation_depth_limit.description: Maximum depth of agent-to-agent delegation chains.

execute_max_tool_rounds_ceiling.description: Hard ceiling for Execute rounds across extensions.

executor_always_on_tools.description: Tools Execute always has, whatever the plan named.

extension_round_step.description: Maximum rounds one extension call may grant.

max_tool_rounds.description: Tool rounds within one Execute run.

onboarding_max_tool_rounds.description: Rounds for the first-turn onboarding pass; 0 disables it.

onboarding_max_tool_rounds_ceiling.description: Hard ceiling for onboarding rounds across extensions.

plan_max_tool_rounds.description: Tool rounds within one Plan run.

plan_max_tool_rounds_ceiling.description: Hard ceiling for Plan rounds across extensions.

sandbox_budget_fraction.description: Share of the seat's remaining budget a sandboxed Execute may use.

sandbox_min_budget_tokens.description: Refuse a sandboxed Execute below this remaining budget.

subagent_batch_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap on a whole batched spawn.

subagent_budget_fraction.description: Share of the parent's remaining budget a sub-agent may use.

subagent_max_parallel.description: Sub-agents run concurrently in one batch.

subagent_max_turns.description: Tool rounds one sub-agent may run.

subagent_min_per_child_tokens.description: Floor on a child's token slice; below it the batch is refused.

channel.description: Unit channel on the company's chat surface; inherited by child units.

goals.description: What this unit is working toward.

knowledge.description: Free-text knowledge references. Not a read scope.

lead.description: Seat leading this unit; inherited from the parent when empty.

mcp_env.description: Credentials inherited by this unit's direct members.

name.description: Unit name; also what a manages entry can reference.

schedules.description: Recurring work owned by this unit.

confluence.description: The Confluence space this unit owns.

jira.description: The Jira project this unit owns.

mcp_servers.description: Tool servers, stdio or http. Per-agent credentials live in role.mcp_env.

mission.description: One line on what the company is for; reaches every seat's prompt.

name.description: Company name. Half of every seat's derived id — effectively permanent.

notification_coalesce_max_batch.description: Events merged into one digest trigger.

notification_coalesce_window_seconds.description: Inbox linger before dispatch, 0..60s. 0 adds no latency.

policies.description: Company-wide rules injected into every seat's prompt.

skill_variables.description: name -> value facts substituted into tool-skill text. Keys must be identifiers.

token_budget.description: Org-wide token ceiling across all seats; 0 = unlimited.

units.description: The org hierarchy; units nest to any depth.

vision.description: Longer statement of where the company is going.
